name: Aseed Holdings Co.,Ltd.
summary: Aseed Holdings Co.,Ltd. operates in the vending machine operations and retail business in Japan. The company operates, manages, and maintains vending machines for paper cup beverages, canned and bottled beverages, paper-pack beverages, snacks, etc. It also manufactures and sells carbonated beverages and coffee-based beverages, as well as low-alcohol beverages; and provides contract manufacturing services. In addition, the company engages in the planning, sale, and system management of cards and related devices for beverage vending machines; and offers an integrated service system of coffees, beverages, etc. Further, it develops and leases office buildings, commercial facilities, etc. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Fukuyama, Japan.
